body.name: Coupled exact-support invariant \(\Gamma_{\mathcal I}(G)\)
body.construction: Compile \(G\) into the finite family of Gaussian-elimination pivot charts for \(\mathcal D_G\), recording on each chart all local rank minors, punctured-coordinate nonvanishing polynomials, Hall--Rado subspace ranks, intervention principal minors, rational response maps \(T_S\), visible-column proportionality minors, source-surjection types, and latent-label orbit representatives.
